stock.description: Sky Light Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise, specializing in the conceptualization, production, and global distribution of diverse digital imaging solutions. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses devices such as home surveillance cameras, professional police cameras, video conferencing units, immersive 360-degree cameras, baby monitors, and remote learning tools. The company supplies advanced imaging products, including 4K 360° VR cameras, dashboard cameras, body-worn cameras, and action cameras, alongside a suite of smart home imaging products like intelligent IP cameras, video doorbells, and connected baby monitors. Furthermore, Sky Light Holdings provides sophisticated video analytics capabilities, offering features such as facial recognition, infant sleep monitoring, baby smile detection, and people tracking with route analysis. It also offers specialized joint design manufacturing (JDM) and original design manufacturing (ODM) services. Established in 2000 and headquartered in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China, the company maintains an international footprint, serving markets in the United States, Mainland China, the European Union, and Hong Kong.
